Thanks — ran numbers against the L5 Manager band and current comp pressure in SF market. Key points: 1) Title: Manager is acceptable if the role includes expected direct-report scope within 6 months and the job description is updated to reflect people management responsibilities. 2) Band placement: for a candidate with Anya's experience (4 yrs individual contributor + 2 yrs tech lead mentoring), target comp should be mid-to-high L5 Manager: base $210k–$230k, OTE-ish constraints aside. 3) Equity: recommend 0.28–0.45% vests; sign-on: up to $30k to close. 4) Budget: current req MGD-128 has nominal buffer for mid-L5 Manager with low sign-on.

My recommendation: offer L5 Manager title, base $220k, equity 0.35%, sign-on $20k. This keeps us competitive while staying within hiring manager budget. If Tessa confirms org will provide the people scope within 6 months, we can proceed.

Notes: If we keep IC title, we should drop base to $195k and increase sign-on as a make-whole.
